```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.tcr.Instance("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    instanceType: "standard",
    deleteBucket: true,
    tags: {
        createdBy: "Terraform",
    },
});
const exampleNamespace = new tencentcloud.tcr.Namespace("example", {
    instanceId: example.id,
    name: "tf-example",
    isPublic: true,
    isAutoScan: true,
    isPreventVul: true,
    severity: "medium",
});
const exampleServiceAccount = new tencentcloud.tcr.ServiceAccount("example", {
    registryId: example.id,
    name: "tf-example",
    permissions: [{
        resource: exampleNamespace.name,
        actions: [
            "tcr:PushRepository",
            "tcr:PullRepository",
        ],
    }],
    description: "tf example for tcr custom account",
    duration: 10,
    disable: false,
    password: "Password123",
    tags: {
        createdBy: "Terraform",
    },
});
```

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/tcr"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		example, err := tcr.NewInstance(ctx, "example", &tcr.InstanceArgs{
			Name:         pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			InstanceType: pulumi.String("standard"),
			DeleteBucket: pulumi.Bool(true),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"createdBy": pulumi.String("Terraform"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		exampleNamespace, err := tcr.NewNamespace(ctx, "example", &tcr.NamespaceArgs{
			InstanceId:   example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Name:         pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			IsPublic:     pulumi.Bool(true),
			IsAutoScan:   pulumi.Bool(true),
			IsPreventVul: pulumi.Bool(true),
			Severity:     pulumi.String("medium"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = tcr.NewServiceAccount(ctx, "example", &tcr.ServiceAccountArgs{
			RegistryId: example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Name:       pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			Permissions: tcr.ServiceAccountPermissionArray{
				&tcr.ServiceAccountPermissionArgs{
					Resource: exampleNamespace.Name,
					Actions: pulumi.StringArray{
						pulumi.String("tcr:PushRepository"),
						pulumi.String("tcr:PullRepository"),
					},
				},
			},
			Description: pulumi.String("tf example for tcr custom account"),
			Duration:    pulumi.Int(10),
			Disable:     pulumi.Bool(false),
			Password:    pulumi.String("Password123"),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"createdBy": pulumi.String("Terraform"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Tcr.Instance;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Tcr.InstanceArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Tcr.Namespace;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Tcr.NamespaceArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Tcr.ServiceAccount;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Tcr.ServiceAccountArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Tcr.inputs.ServiceAccountPermissionArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var example = new Instance("example", InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example")
            .instanceType("standard")
            .deleteBucket(true)
            .tags(Map.of("createdBy", "Terraform"))
            .build());

        var exampleNamespace = new Namespace("exampleNamespace", NamespaceArgs.builder()
            .instanceId(example.id())
            .name("tf-example")
            .isPublic(true)
            .isAutoScan(true)
            .isPreventVul(true)
            .severity("medium")
            .build());

        var exampleServiceAccount = new ServiceAccount("exampleServiceAccount", ServiceAccountArgs.builder()
            .registryId(example.id())
            .name("tf-example")
            .permissions(ServiceAccountPermissionArgs.builder()
                .resource(exampleNamespace.name())
                .actions(                
                    "tcr:PushRepository",
                    "tcr:PullRepository")
                .build())
            .description("tf example for tcr custom account")
            .duration(10)
            .disable(false)
            .password("Password123")
            .tags(Map.of("createdBy", "Terraform"))
            .build());

    }
}

## Import



TCR service account can be imported using the registryId#accountName, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Tcr/serviceAccount:ServiceAccount example tcr-ixgt2l0z#tf-example
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
